title: novaterragov
description: Build civilizations, not claims. Create territories, recruit citizens, progress through ranks, and forge your legacy in Novaterra.
body:
NovaterraGov v1.1.0 — Description

NovaterraGov is a civilization-based territory plugin that replaces traditional land claiming with a structured progression system. Players develop from Nomads into rulers of civilizations, managing territories, citizens, and progression systems.


---

Main Features

Civilization Progression

Players advance through ranks: Nomad → Hunter → Baron → Citizen → Count
Each rank represents increased authority and access to territory systems.


---

Territory System

Create and manage a personal territory

Limited system: 1 player = 1 territory, 1 world = 4 territories

Territory size ranges from 30×30 to 80×80

Requires 1000 coins to create

Automatic hidden protection via RedProtect



---

Citizen System

Players can request to join territories

Territory owners (Barons) manage requests via GUI

Accept or deny citizenship applications

Citizens become official residents of a territory



---

Territory Immersion

Entry and exit titles when moving between territories

Wilderness transition system

Border visual effects for territories

Fully immersive civilization feel



---

Administration System

Territory information panel

Citizen management interface

Join request handling

Territory configuration tools



---

Commands

Player Commands

/teririority - open gui
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



</details>



/territory create — Create a new territory (requires rank Baron and 1000 coins)

/territory info — View your territory information

/territory leave — Leave current territory (if allowed)

/territory join <name> — Request to join a territory



---

Owner / Baron Commands

/territory accept <player> — Accept citizen request

/territory deny <player> — Deny citizen request

/territory citizens — View citizen list (GUI)

/territory manage — Open territory management panel



---

Requirements

Paper Server

Vault

LuckPerms

Economy plugin

RedProtect (recommended)



---

NovaterraGov focuses on creating meaningful civilizations where every territory has value, structure, and progression.
